# Spider-Man Hero Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, unofficial Spider-Man hero quiz in chat, just for fun. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, and names the hero that fits your answers best, with a short explanation. It is not a personality test, and it is not an official quiz.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Marvel or Disney. No official text, image, emblem, music, or quiz is copied here. Just for fun, not a real personality test. The heroes are fictional characters only, never actors.
